highlights: Fix panel positioning on macOS Tahoe, updated statusline

changes.text: Panel positioning (left, right, fullscreen) now works on macOS Tahoe where Apple blocks window repositioning for MenuBarExtra windows
Robust window detection that no longer relies on private Apple class names, compatible across all macOS versions
Statusline script now shows total and per-message token usage (input/output)

highlights: Fix repeated Accessibility permission prompt

changes.text: Accessibility permission dialog now only appears once per app session instead of on every interaction

highlights: Toggle to disable tool error notifications, deferred Accessibility prompt

changes.text: Setting to disable tool error notifications in the Notifications tab
Accessibility permission prompt is now deferred to first use instead of appearing at app launch

highlights: Auto Mode toggle in settings, fix app relaunch after update

changes.text: Auto Mode toggle in General settings to enable Claude Code auto mode via ~/.claude/settings.local.json
App now reliably relaunches after applying an update (waits for old process to exit before opening new instance)

highlights: Improved button press styling

changes.text: Submit and Send buttons now darken on press instead of flashing yellow, keeping the orange accent consistent

highlights: Simplified follow-up input with reusable SendTextField component

changes.text: Follow-up input is now always visible as a text field with Send button, replacing the previous "+" menu that required extra clicks
Removed Contract mode from follow-up actions in favor of the simpler direct text input
Unified all text+send input patterns across the app into a single reusable component

highlights: Fix response routing to correct terminal tab

changes.text: AskUserQuestion and elicitation responses now route to the correct terminal tab using transcript-based tty resolution, even with multiple concurrent sessions
Numbered lists in conversation content no longer appear as false interactive option buttons
Open in Terminal is now faster and reliably closes the panel after switching
Removed heavy per-tab diagnostic logging that slowed down terminal matching

highlights: Internal maintenance and improvements

changes.text: Internal maintenance and minor improvements

highlights: Fix Terminal.app tab matching on non-standard windows

changes.text: Terminal.app tab matching no longer crashes on non-standard windows (Inspector, Preferences) that don't support tab enumeration
Diagnostic logging dumps all Terminal.app tab info (tty, processes, lsof cwd) before matching, visible in /tmp/claudebell.log
AppleScript errors now go to the log file instead of stdout for easier debugging

highlights: Open in Terminal now reliably finds the correct tab

changes.text: Open in Terminal now selects the correct tab by checking each tab's real working directory via tty, instead of relying on window title (which only reflects the active tab)
Terminal.app tab matching no longer fails silently when a tab causes an AppleScript error
AskUserQuestion response flow and keyboard handling improved

highlights: Auto-update system: get notified of new versions and update in one click

changes.text: Auto-update checker fetches the latest version from the server on launch and every 30 minutes
Update banner appears in the panel when a new version is available, showing version and highlights
One-click "Update Now" downloads, installs, and relaunches the app automatically
"Check for Updates..." option added to the right-click menu for manual update checks
Dismiss an update to hide it until the next release

highlights: Open in Terminal no longer denies permission, last user prompt shown in session info

changes.text: "Open in Terminal" on permission requests now focuses the terminal and closes the panel without sending a deny response to the webhook
Session rows and permission detail views now display the last user prompt extracted from the conversation transcript

highlights: Open in Terminal works after Claude exits

changes.text: "Open in Terminal" now finds the correct tab even after the Claude process has exited, using cwd-based fallback matching

highlights: First-launch setup prompt, reliable follow-up delivery after task complete

changes.text: First-launch setup overlay prompts new users to install Claude Code hooks, explaining that the app won't receive events without them
Skip option lets users defer hook installation and set up later from Settings
Follow-up prompts after Task Complete now reliably deliver to the terminal using native commands instead of simulated keystrokes
Terminal tab matching works even after Claude Code exits, using cwd-based fallback

highlights: Always Allow as default, configurable panel width, download button shows version

changes.text: Permission prompts now default to the Always Allow button when it is available, reducing friction for trusted tools
Panel width can now be configured in settings
Website download button now displays the current version number

highlights: Follow-up actions for Task Completed notifications with Prompt and Contract modes

changes.text: Task Completed notifications now show follow-up action buttons to continue working with Claude directly from the panel
Prompt mode lets you type a follow-up message that gets sent back to Claude after a task finishes
Contract mode provides a focused input field that auto-focuses when the panel opens
Accessibility permission is requested on launch so ClaudeBell can paste follow-up text into Claude
Paste-to-return delay increased for more reliable follow-up delivery

highlights: Enter key now activates highlighted buttons when selectable text has focus

changes.text: Enter key now correctly activates highlighted buttons (Dismiss, Allow, etc.) even when selectable text in the panel has focus

highlights: Fix race condition where concurrent hooks auto-denied pending permission requests

changes.text: Concurrent hook events no longer incorrectly auto-deny pending permission requests — only a new PermissionRequest or session end will clear them

highlights: Stop hook detects questions, smarter Always Allow button

changes.text: Stop notifications now detect pending questions and show interactive input instead of passive 'Task Completed'
Always Allow button only appears when permission suggestions are available

highlights: Reorganized settings tabs with custom tab bar

changes.text: Global Shortcut moved to General tab for easier access
Panel Position moved to Appearance tab
macOS Notifications moved to Notifications tab
New Miscellaneous tab for Status Line configuration
Settings tabs now use a custom tab bar that stays visible (fixes macOS collapsing tabs into a dropdown)

highlights: Settings in a dedicated macOS window with tabbed layout

changes.text: Settings now open in a separate floating window (macOS best practice)
Tabbed settings layout: General, Notifications, and Appearance
⌘, keyboard shortcut to open Settings from anywhere
"Settings..." option in right-click context menu
Panel now always shows operational content — no more inline settings view

highlights: What's New panel no longer closes the menu bar, changelog accessible from right-click menu

changes.text: Dismissing "What's New" no longer closes the entire panel (replaced sheet with inline overlay)
"What's New" option in right-click menu to browse the full changelog anytime

highlights: Fix custom text in question notifications, hide session ended noise

changes.text: Custom text in question notifications now correctly sends the 'type something else' option first, then the typed text
Session ended notifications no longer clutter the panel

highlights: Panel position setting with Menu Bar, Left, Right, and Fullscreen options

changes.text: Panel position setting: choose between Menu Bar, Left, Right, or Fullscreen
HookResponse JSON escaping for tool names
Landing page architecture diagram refresh

highlights: Notification body style customization, dark theme, consistent styling across all views

changes.text: Customizable notification body: background color, font color, and font type
Appearance toggle (System / Light / Dark) to force theme independently from macOS
Inline color swatches with hex input for color selection
Live preview of style settings in the Settings panel
Body style settings now apply to all notification types: questions, plans, tool inputs, and text responses

highlights: What's New panel and website changelog

changes.text: "What's New" panel shown on first launch after an update
Changelog section on the website, loaded from changelog.json

highlights: Mute toggle, renameable sessions, install confirmations

changes.text: Mute/unmute from right-click menu with bell.slash icon
Rename sessions by clicking the project name in detail views
Confirmation dialog before installing hooks and statusline
macOS notifications disabled by default, opt-in via Settings
